exposure: trial of labor after cesarean section (TOLAC)
time interval of less than 18 months
higher uterine incision due to placenta previa or isthmic myoma
cohort: 63 women with a previous Cesarean section (CS)
finding: A higher periconceptional CS scar-VVF distance was significantly associated with an increased risk of pre-labor UR in women with a previous CS.
